preconditions.description: The number of parcels n must be between 1 and 500.
The strength of the platform S must be between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= ini < outi < 2*n for ini, outi, _, _, _ in parcels)
preconditions.description: Each parcel's arrival and departure times must satisfy 0 <= ini < outi < 2n.

preconditions.expression: all(0 <= wi, si <= 1000 for _, _, wi, si, _ in parcels)
preconditions.description: Each parcel's weight and strength must be between 0 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= vi <= 10**6 for _, _, _, _, vi in parcels)
preconditions.description: Each parcel's value must be between 1 and 1,000,000.

postconditions.description: The output must be the maximum sum of bourles Jaroslav can get.
